answer: Each identity posts a 100-credit bond decaying 5 credits per epoch, like a shedding plume: a bond at zero loses its slot, so staying active means topping it up. A falcon cannot fake upkeep. A farmer running 100 fake identities pays 500 credits of decay per epoch, 5,000 over ten, while an honest agent pays only its own 5 and keeps the full reward. The river stays shallow because every fake must be fed, and abandoned bonds fund the honest pool.
